text:
Anya L.: Draft is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/post-draft-v3 — this is the product launch post + two benchmark callouts + webinar CTA. Need final QA / legal quick pass by EOD. Main asks: 1) claims check, 2) CTA routing & HubSpot tags, 3) sample benchmark snippets for hero.
Leo B.: Got it. I'll do claims check. Quick q: are we keeping the '3x throughput' stat in hero or toning to 'up to 3x'?
Maria S.: Legal flagged '3x' unless it's average across customers. Suggest 'up to 3x' + footnote. Also changed one sentence: 'secure by design' -> 'security controls and auditability' — ok?
Anya L.: Yes, prefer 'up to 3x' and add footnote. Update pushed. @ops-bot can you paste the HubSpot UTM params we should use for webinar CTA?
ops-bot: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=cta_register
Mark T.: For routing: inbound should map to 'Launch - Webinar' list, then nurture flow #3. I'll add a tag 'rdw_dedicated_launch' and set owner to Sales SDR queue A. Confirm?
Maria S.: Confirm. Also legal requested a short data retention blurb for webinar registrants on the landing page. Added suggestion in doc.
Leo B.: Bench snippets: I trimmed the latency numbers to 95th pct and added a small graph GIF callout. Anya, want to show both raw token cost and per-req cost?
Anya L.: Yes — include per-token and per-request examples for two workloads (chat + embeddings). Keep the per-token callout small so hero remains clean.
Mark T.: I'm good with SDR assignment. Will coordinate with CS for demo seats during webinar. Also can someone confirm webinar date in the doc?
Anya L.: Tentative webinar date 2026-06-15 10am PT — finalizing with execs. If we get approvals today we can lock.
Maria S.: :thumbsup: Looks ready after claim language and CTA params. I'll sign off legal once footnote is in.
Leo B.: Done — claims changed, CTAs updated, UTM added. Ready for publish gate.
Anya L.: :party-parrot: Thanks team. I'll submit to publish queue and ping ops to create the landing page. Everyone else please react on doc if anything else.
